title: Work order lines are visible whenever Work orders View is ON
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View ON and Work order lines Create & Edit and Delete OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open a work order that has lines.
  2. Look at the lines area.
  3. Try to edit a line.
  4. Try to add a new line.
custom_expected:
The lines are visible (line items, labor, parts).

The user cannot edit a line.

There is no Add line option.
evidence: UI (Time Clock User = WO View only): work order lines are visible (line items/labor/parts) but there is no New Line/add option and no edit controls — lines visible whenever WO View is on. screenshot wol-tcuLines.
